question:
In a rectangular prism, consider an edge of the top base and an edge of the bottom base that is neither parallel to it nor in the same lateral face. These edges:

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_h114_q2_question_en.svg)
solution: The two edges lie in distinct parallel base planes, so their supporting lines cannot intersect, even when extended. The question also states that they are not parallel. If these lines were coplanar, they would therefore intersect, a contradiction. Edges that are not coplanar and are not parallel are skew lines. Thus the edges must be skew, so A is the only valid choice.
